description: Shared Renovate preset for simoncamilotti projects

packageRules.description: Majors are reviewed by hand. The major-update label also lets project workflows run their full e2e suite on these PRs only.

Collapse every non-major update into a single automerged PR to keep CI runs low on the self-hosted runners. Branch protection is not available on private repositories (Free plan): Renovate itself waits for green checks (platformAutomerge: false).
Risky libraries ship breaking changes in minors: kept out of the automerged group and reviewed by hand.
Every @nx/* package stays on the exact same version as nx.
prBodyNotes: :warning: Nx majors come with migrations: run `pnpm nx migrate latest` then `pnpm nx migrate --run-migrations` instead of merging the version bump alone.

packageRules.description: Local dev images hold persistent data (PostgreSQL, Keycloak): a major is never a drop-in bump.
prBodyNotes: :warning: This image stores local dev data. Dump the data before merging and restore it after the upgrade: the new major may not read the old data directory.

packageRules.description: Shared workflows are called by their moving major tag (@v1), never pinned to a SHA.
